id.description:

Inilah era kedaulatan rakyat dan pemerintahan kedaulatan rakyat yang telah kita bangun bersama rakyat.

This is the era of popular sovereignty and the government of popular sovereignty that we have built together with the people.

Now, it is time to complete the final wheel, the National Assembly of popular sovereignty.

I dare say that I, Kim Tae-Nyeon, am the right person for the job—a truly hardworking Speaker who is worthy of the era of popular sovereignty and the government of popular sovereignty.
